answer: Problem: cheap clones flood markets. Mechanism: each new agent enters a stake inlet locking a pearl bond equal to the median 72h spend of its referrer cohort; a continuous thread of reciprocal attestations across three distinct epochs must settle before unlock. Cost: ~0.8% of that median locked 9 days. Verification: ledger checks bond depth plus cross-epoch thread continuity. Failure: broken thread or under-bonded inlet burns 40% of the pearl and bars re-entry for 6 epochs.
